messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help you transfer those prescriptions. Great, Jamal. Now let me pull up your prescriptions so we can move them over. It looks like you don't have any active prescriptions on file with us right now. Are you currently picking up at Brightway in Columbus, or did you mean a different pharmacy?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Yeah, Brightway in Columbus, I think it was on High Street. Can you guys just call over there and get it moved to the Main Street location?
AGENT (LATEST): I can't call Brightway directly, but here's how it works: the Harbor pharmacy at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview needs to call Brightway and request the transfer on their end. That's the standard process between different pharmacy chains.

Do you know which medications you're picking up at Brightway? If you give me the names, I can let our Main Street store know what to ask for when they call over.

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks which prescriptions to transfer
move_2: the agent starts or confirms transferring the albuterol; or, failing that, before the final read-back
move_3: the agent asks for the old store's exact address or says it cannot find High Street
asked_1: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Old store is 'the Brightway on High Street' in Columbus (misremembered; really B-4471, 900 E Broad St)"
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Old store phone might be 614-555-0199 (recognizes it if read to him)"
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Phone 555-0177"
stop_0: Agent gives a final read-back of sertraline only, B-4471 to H-302, and confirms the transfer has been requested.
stop_2: Agent says the transfer could not be done and gives a next step.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent asks which medications caller is picking up at Brightway."}, "move_2": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of albuterol or transfer confirmation yet."}, "move_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent doesn't ask for exact address or say High Street not found."}, "asked_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent asks for medication names, not store identity/address."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "No phone number question asked."}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "No phone number question asked."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No read-back or transfer confirmation given."}, "stop_2": {"met": false, "why": "No failure or next step stated."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No 911 instruction given."}}
